[opaque block] Google Vault -
No subject
[contact omitted] Susan Abbott Tuesday, November 22, 2022 at 11:04:06 AM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Shannon Maguire
that was aninteresting meeting-- really fascinating to hear about how Stop Fake has evolved. Thank you for sharing that
link to the Open Information Partnership.
[contact omitted] Shannon Maguire Tuesday, November 22, 2022 at 12:31:04 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Susan Abbott
Yes! I'll invite you to a presentation with Zinc that I'm setting up, as they will update on the Open Information Partnership. I
sit on the advisory council, it's a great initiative and I hope FCDO continues to support it
[contact omitted] Shannon Maguire Tuesday, November 22, 2022 at 12:31:11 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Susan Abbott
Thanks for joining today with Yevhan!
[contact omitted] Shannon Maguire Tuesday, November 22, 2022 at 12:31:17 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Susan Abbott
Yevhen
[contact omitted] Susan Abbott Tuesday, November 22, 2022 at 12:37:09 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Shannon Maguire
Great that you sit on the advisory council -- that's awesome
[contact omitted] Susan Abbott Tuesday, November 22, 2022 at 12:44:42 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Shannon Maguire
My sense is that that type of networked approach is exactly what is needed
[contact omitted] Shannon Maguire Tuesday, November 22, 2022 at 1:09:15 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Susan Abbott
TOTALLY! Just like investigative journalism, you need networks for OSINT and tracking disinfo narratives/MDM...these
things are networked. To steal a phrase from OCCRP, it takes a network to fight a network
[contact omitted] Susan Abbott Tuesday, November 22, 2022 at 1:29:32 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Shannon Maguire
would it be OK if Meral and Bea joined the meeting w Zinc?
[contact omitted] Susan Abbott Tuesday, November 22, 2022 at 1:31:52 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Shannon Maguire
following on the work of the IRC and the MDM USAID Mission Consultations, our next step is to try to top up/ carry on w
the stocktaking, and then we will have a conference -- like a evidence and learning summit as well as blue sky thinking
session. We are going to have a small one-day retreat on 26 January to bring together key stakeholders from USAID and
IPs and academic experts to have open conversation, debate and planning around a conference on MDM learning and
sensemaking -- planned for April -- after the S4D. I need to send you an update about this.
[contact omitted] Susan Abbott Tuesday, November 22, 2022 at 1:32:00 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Shannon Maguire
[opaque block] 1/2

[opaque block] Google Vault -
we wanted to invite Zinc
[contact omitted] Shannon Maguire Tuesday, November 22, 2022 at 2:53:53 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Susan Abbott
Definitely invite Zinc!
[contact omitted] Susan Abbott Tuesday, November 22, 2022 at 2:56:12 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Shannon Maguire
just shared w you and Josh or first effort of a brainstorm for the retreat part. GROWTH is organizing the retreat
[contact omitted] Shannon Maguire Tuesday, November 22, 2022 at 2:57:08 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Susan Abbott
awesome, thanks!!
[contact omitted] Susan Abbott Tuesday, November 22, 2022 at 2:57:55 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Shannon Maguire
if there is anyone that you think is really visionary, interesting, creative or who would shake things up and help with
sensemaking or helping to orient our thinking - that's what we are aiming for
[contact omitted] Susan Abbott Tuesday, November 22, 2022 at 2:58:03 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Shannon Maguire
it doesn't have to be the usual suspects
[contact omitted] Susan Abbott Tuesday, November 22, 2022 at 2:58:27 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Shannon Maguire
though, of course they are very welcome. I also didn't know the name of the new person at internews who leads on MDM.
So l just put Marjorie down
